method: Poisson sex + categorical year, separate model per age and outcome; log population offset; quasi-Poisson Pearson dispersion floored at 1 with t CI; unscaled Poisson CI retained for audit; exclude-2025 sensitivity
standard: Chile adult both-sex population, 30 June 2015, seven age bands
scope: Discharges, not incident persons. No correction for suppressed records or repeated admissions; population projection treated fixed.
